hypothesis: A frozen V10 candidate with absolute top-of-book imbalance of at least 25 percent will retain positive five, 30 and 300 second markouts after the same two-cent round-trip cost stress.

evidence_basis.interpretation: Weak-imbalance observations were nonpositive at short horizons. The sole strong-imbalance event was positive at all horizons, which suggests a prospective test but cannot establish profitability.

automatic_rejection.gate_failure: Reject if any required horizon is nonpositive after 100 complete signals and 30 independent events.
automatic_rejection.early_stop: Reject after 15 independent events if the event-cluster mean is at or below minus one cent at any required horizon.

next_stage_if_gate_passes: A separately authorized one-contract Demo execution trial with actual-fee accounting.
